title: The life of Homer’s Phaeacians
html_source:
The Phaeacians took Odysseus/Ulysses in after Nausicaa came across a shipped up Odysseus in the buff.

They were eventually an audience to him and his retelling of the lost years. Their king, Alcinous

insisted he be given ships to return to Ithaca for which they were later punished by Poseidon.

That’s it though, they were nothing else: a vessel for the hero, ie AE,Lister and Best and their predictable ejaculations serve only to further Stephen in his search for epiphany.
